query:
SELECT t.id AS "id: i32", t.name,
                      COALESCE(t.created_at, '') AS "created_at!: String"
               FROM tag t
               JOIN mem_tag mt ON mt.tag_id = t.id
               JOIN mem m ON m.id = mt.mem_id
               WHERE mt.mem_id = ?1
                 AND (?2 IS NULL OR m.user_id = ?2)
                 AND (?2 IS NULL OR t.user_id = ?2)
               ORDER BY t.name
